name: District police portals of Mymensingh Range (Jamalpur, Sherpur, Netrokona)
organization: Bangladesh Police — district police units of Mymensingh Range
attribution: District and thana police portals (police.<district>.gov.bd, police.<upazila>.<district>.gov.bd)
notes: No licence stated. SP offices from the Superintendent's officer card; thanas from each upazila's thana portal officer cards (office landline, OC's police official mobile, *.gov.bd e-mail); for Jamalpur, missing thana contacts, the river-police thana and the control room from the SP portal's posts table (official mobiles and police.gov.bd e-mails, no names). Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. Mymensingh Range (Range DIG's office, policedig.mymensinghdiv.gov.bd; 'এক নজরে': formed by gazette of 12 Oct 2015 from the division's 4 districts) covers Mymensingh, Jamalpur, Sherpur and Netrokona; Mymensingh District is in MYMENSINGH_POLICE_2026. There is no metropolitan police in the division. Thanas that are not upazilas have no portal here; Netrokona's thana phone list is an image and is not used. Thana counts (Jamalpur 8 incl. the Bahadurabad river-police thana, Netrokona 10) from police.gov.bd's Mymensingh Range page (undated).
